directive.gatingQuestion: Can current source-addressed evidence lawfully close the missing valuation, governance and remaining numeric factor evidence required for APH's 12-component scoreRecord?
directive.whyItMatters: The scoreRecord remains blocked until the remaining components are numerically source-addressed.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: Latest authorized market/valuation observation plus latest proxy/10-Q/10-K and issuer transaction/integration disclosures.
lawfulFallbacks: issuer investor-relations transaction and earnings materials
directive.successCondition: Every remaining required component has source-addressed numeric evidence sufficient for the canonical scorer without manufactured values.

findings.claim: The active packet already contains strong sourced qualitative evidence on operating momentum, CCS integration, pricing effects, supply-chain exposure and cash generation, but explicitly lacks canonical live valuation/entry evidence.

The routed defect is not lack of broad underwriting; it is lack of methodology-addressed numeric evidence. Converting qualitative integration, margin or governance facts into numeric component values without an authorized mapping would manufacture evidence.

unavailableEvidence: remaining methodology-addressed numeric factor evidence including governancePower
